title: Plan catalog and a billing line per site deployment (account by product)
description:
As an operator, I attach a plan to one site deployment on a client account, so that each deployment is billed on its own.

Feature: Billing lines
  Scenario: Reviewed plan catalog
    Given accounts/billing-plans.json lists plan id, display name, product family (papyrus-site, cyclotron-lab), interval and a Stripe price id per Stripe mode (test, live)
    When the service starts
    Then an unknown field, duplicate plan id or price id shared by two plans stops it before serving
  Scenario: Create a line
    Given an account with an active entitlement for papyrus-example-invalid and a billing profile
    When an operator creates a line with plan papyrus-site-monthly
    Then billing/lines/<account>/papyrus-example-invalid.json exists with status pending (direct mode, until a Stripe subscription is active) or active (invoiced mode), and the journal records it
  Scenario: Two sites, two lines
    Given one account entitled to two Papyrus site products
    When lines are created for both
    Then each line has its own status, plan and period, and ending one does not touch the other
  Scenario: Line without entitlement
    Given a product the account is not entitled to
    When an operator creates a line for it
    Then it is refused with a message naming the missing entitlement; billing never grants access
  Scenario: End a line
    Given an active line
    When the operator ends it with an end date
    Then the line is ended, the entitlement is unchanged, and a follow-up note says whether the product should be disabled through the entitlement route

Done looks like: `billing/plans.ts` (catalog validation at synth and runtime, like `accounts/papyrus-sites.ts`), `billing/lines.ts`, operator routes under `/v1/account-directory/operator/accounts/{id}/billing-lines[/{product}]`, listing for the CRM and the portal.

Data touched: `accounts/billing-plans.json` (new reviewed file, test-mode price ids only until live keys exist), `prospectus-central/billing/lines/`.

Specs: `features/billing-lines.feature`; `billing/plans.test.ts`, `billing/lines.test.ts`; an infra test that a malformed catalog fails synthesis.

comments.text: 2026-10-31 (Billing planner): product family names and display names come from kanbus-db57cb's site metadata (family 'papyrus'); this story's 'papyrus-site' placeholder should follow that. Entitlement events from kanbus-6efecd prompt operators to create or end lines; they do not create lines automatically (epic open question 13).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Ryan's decisions 2026-10-31:
- Pricing is out of scope for this epic. Build the catalog's structure with test-mode placeholder plans and prices; real plans and prices are a separate decision.
- One combined invoice per client: a billing line becomes a subscription item (direct mode) or an invoice line item (invoiced mode), not its own subscription or invoice.
